title: Open-source codec workflow and comparator-selection gates
mode: Primary-source cross-project research and plan reconciliation
scope: Compare current primary project documentation for LibreDWG, ACadSharp, ezdxf, and FreeCAD to select the correct comparator by unresolved pipeline stage.
Refine existing PAR-07/S8 artifact, identity, warning, recovery, consumer, and semantic evidence boundaries.
Preserve fast local implementation cadence and existing hostile-input/fuzz milestone without adding peer dependencies or tests.

sources.revision: Current public manual and repository pages inspected 2026-10-20; no source commit or executable was pinned or run.
sources.observed: The manual describes JSON as a readable 1:1 mapping of LibreDWG's structures with more information than DXF; it documents route-specific DWG/DXF/JSON input, read-write, and output tools/fuzz frontends, and notes that unknown classes/objects may remain binary blobs without DXF codes.
sources.limits: The JSON is LibreDWG's internal structure representation, not a neutral standard, normative field definition, independent semantic oracle, or blanket writer qualification. Mutable pages and docs do not establish a particular binary's behavior.

sources.revision: Mutable master README and documentation inspected 2026-10-20; no release, package, or executable was pinned or run.
sources.observed: The README declares DXF/DWG reader and writer capability by version and direction, with matrix cells that differ. The reading example exposes notifications for warnings and informational messages.
sources.limits: A declared matrix cell and sample API do not establish tested per-entity completeness, released-artifact behavior, native acceptance, or geometry semantics.

sources.revision: Stable documentation pages inspected 2026-10-20; no package artifact or runtime was pinned or run.
sources.observed: The docs distinguish ordinary DXF loading from explicit recovery for flawed files, provide an entity-class inventory including 3D/modeler and proxy families, and document a narrower XREF copy/transform subset with unsupported-entity/object limitations.
sources.limits: Documentation does not prove a particular installed package's behavior. Recovery/audit output is not a strict-parse pass, and entity inventory or XREF behavior does not establish whole-document preservation.

sources.revision: Mutable documentation main branch inspected 2026-10-20; no source commit or native application build was pinned or run.
sources.observed: The docs describe DWG conversion through a selected external converter and separate the downstream DXF importer/format behavior from conversion. They identify 2D and modeler-carrier boundaries at the application layer.
sources.limits: Documentation is a route-selection aid, not native Linux/Windows qualification or independent ACIS/SAB geometry evidence.

sources.revision: Shared worktree plan inspected and updated 2026-10-20.
sources.observed: PAR-07/S8 now has a named comparator-selection sequence: identify the unresolved stage; pin one matching peer artifact; compare source identity/disposition; record strict parse, recovery, downstream consumer, and semantic results separately; retain local fast checks and existing milestone-only external/fuzz gates.
sources.limits: No peer runtime, native CAD application, geometry kernel, or external drawing was used. This plan refinement does not resolve external qualification items.

existingSubplansRefined: PAR-07/S8: choose a peer by the exact unanswered stage rather than running all peers or treating project-wide version matrices as complete evidence.
PAR-07/S8: bind peer results to immutable artifact/source, format/version, encoding, direction, options, warning stream, and per-source identity/disposition.

PAR-07/S8: treat LibreDWG JSON as peer-internal structural/field evidence, ACadSharp notifications as warning evidence, ezdxf recovery as distinct from strict parse, and FreeCAD import as downstream application evidence.
PAR-14 safety and validation scheduling: route-matched fuzzing remains milestone-only and parser input, conversion, and writer/output targets remain separate.
Implementation cadence: no external tool, fixture, or full suite becomes a per-slice dependency; unavailable peers self-unblock as NOT_RUN or NOT_APPLICABLE.

planChanges: Added a PAR-07/S8 comparator-selection procedure keyed to the unresolved processing stage and the exact claimed evidence layer.
Specified a compact immutable artifact envelope and per-source handle/type/owner/block identity/disposition ledger for any future peer comparison.

Clarified that LibreDWG's JSON is its own internal structural representation, ACadSharp's matrix is version/direction declaration, ezdxf recovery is not strict parsing, and FreeCAD import is downstream of conversion.
Preserved the fast local per-slice sequence; peer builds and route-matched fuzzing remain at existing composed/security milestones only.
Kept J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 explicitly DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.

ODA v5.4.1 and Autodesk DXF references remain authoritative for their respective byte-layout questions; project documentation and peer matrices are not normative specifications.
No local defect, numbered finding, implementation-order change, fixture, or support promotion was established.
J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
